dataList.content:
Sometimes, I dream.
我偶尔会做梦。

I dream of the burning confessional.
梦见化作火海的告解室。

Of the Kindreds' dismembered bodies and the crumbling rides of the amusement park.
梦见被残忍分尸的家人，以及轰然坍塌的游乐设施。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend Hunter
血魔猎人
dataList.content:
Die...! Filthy, disgusting beasts...
快……去死吧！肮脏的怪物……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend Hunter
血魔猎人
dataList.content:
Look, I've brought water! You need water to put out the fire burning your home to the ground, don't you? Too bad you're too scared to go anywhere near your own salvation... hah!
来，看看吧……这是让你们害怕到不行的水！怎么样？虽然你们想要灭火就必须要用水……哈！

Raiders yell at the top of their lungs as they trample our land.
践踏着我们土地的侵略者们高声叫喊着。

dataList.title:
Family
家族
dataList.content:
W-we... we wanted to live, too...!
我们，我们也……不得不活下去……！

dataList.title:
Family
家族
dataList.content:
Do you have even an inkling of the suffering we'd endured day after day while your kind blissfully frolicked across La Manchaland...?
你们知道当自己嘻嘻哈哈地在拉·曼却领里闲逛时，我们忍耐着怎样的痛苦吗……？

My Family protests, their voices trembling with fear.
家人们用因恐惧而颤抖的声音倾诉着他们的悲哀。

Some beg for their lives, too.
也有些在拼命祈求对方饶自己一命。

dataList.title:
Firefist Office
炎拳事务所
dataList.content:
Today... today's the day I finally reduce this damned place to a pile of ashes.
终于……能把这片不祥的土地全部焚烧殆尽了。

dataList.title:
Firefist Office
炎拳事务所
dataList.content:
Big sis... rest easy now. I'll get you that proper office building you'd always dreamed of.
大姐……安息吧。你曾经梦想的那座气派的大楼……我会为你建起来的。

But my Family never survive this dream.
然而在这梦里，我的家族无一人幸存。

Just as they failed to in the waking world.
梦境之外似乎也是如此。

131 rounds of expeditions.
131次讨伐队远征。

79 attempts at arson, 21 attempts at hosing us down, 3 volleys of trebuchet strikes, 17 total counts of sniper shots and assassination attempts. And 10 all-out battles.
79轮纵火与22轮洒水攻击，3轮投石与17次狙击、暗杀。以及10轮全面战。

671 Kindreds killed. 3,449 Bloodbags burned.
671名家人死亡，3449只血袋被焚烧。

Visions of this dream are as precise as the clarity of my memory. I recall them with the same vividness of that day, recalling the varied ways in which they were killed and the accompanying cries that became their last words.
我清晰地记下了一切，能在梦中鲜明地回忆起他们经历过多少种死法，又如何满含激情地喊出临终之语。

And I do nothing but witness it all from the Parade's vanguard.
我仅仅是在游行队首旁观着那幅场景。

For the first time, the Parade comes to a stop, and my vantage point presents me with a vision of a massacre inflamed by mania...
即便游行第一次停下时，在队首见到的那场景仿佛地狱……

... which is reminiscent of the crowd of humans who once cheered happily at our Parade.
在我看来却与观赏游行时高声欢呼的人类并无太大区别。

So, standing still like a stone, I observe them.
因此我也如往常一般纹丝不动，观察着他们的模样。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
... Meursault. Listen to me.
……默尔索，清醒点。

... The dream is nearing its end.
……梦已经结束了。

At this moment, with mere minutes separating this dream and the waking world, maman always grabs me by my shoulders and calls my name.
在这仅存的几分钟空闲里，妈妈总会抓着我的肩膀那么说。

But I do not answer her.
我没有回答。

Because there is no "Meursault" in the procession. As that is the rule as written, I follow it.
因为游行中没有默尔索。既然规则如此制定，我便必须执行。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
... Haah. In moments like this, I begin to wonder how I understand so little of my own Child.
……哎。虽然是我的孩子，但每到这种时候连我也难以理解你啊。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
... O, noble Prince.
……王子。

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
Have you aught to say, Princess?
公主，你有什么话要说。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
We now stand upon the last vestiges of our kingdom. Those who are green with envy have looted and plundered our land bare.
如您所见，嫉妒王国之徒的侵夺……已经令王国步上了灭亡之路。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
You are the first prince. Its fate now lies solely in your hands; thus—
王国的命运如今只能寄托于身为第一王子的您……

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
Are you suggesting that I flee, Princess?
你是在劝我逃跑吗，公主。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
What other recourse have I to suggest?
除此之外我所说的还能是什么呢。

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
A royal prince must rightly stand his ground, no matter what is to come. He shall fight to the bitter end...
作为一国王子，理应与王国的敌人战斗到最后才是……

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
... I see. If that is your rule, then I suppose no words, regardless of its speaker, would sway you from here.
……是么。如果这是你认为的规则，那么不论谁说什么你都会无动于衷吧。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Allow me to rephrase that, noble Prince.
容我更换说法，王子。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
You are aware of the rule that this march must never stop, correct?
相信您明白……规则上，这场游行不能停止。

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
Indeed. For this is the endlessly, eternally blessed Carnival.
因为这是永无止境的，充满祝福的嘉年华。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
My Prince, you are the vanguard of the procession. Should you stop, you will reave it of its eternity.
王子应处于队伍的最前列……如果失去了您，这条队伍亦会失去其“永无止境”。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Thus, I implore you to march on, dear Prince. March over the ruins of this kingdom and go forward—found a new kingdom, reborn and rewritten by your hands.
所以请您继续行进吧……越过这片王国，直至您抵达足以书写新篇的王国为止。

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
... You mean...?
……你的意思是。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Become King, my Prince.
请您成为王。

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
... If that is your will, Princess, the fairest and the wisest of the kingdom, then...
……如果这就是王国中最睿智又最美丽的公主的旨意。

That was the new rule bestowed upon me.
那其便是施加于我的新规则。

When the request behind a rule is reasonable, I carry it out—no more, no less.
既然这份请求并无不合情理之处，我便只需执行即可。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
... Live.
……活下去吧。

I turn away from the lingering whisper of maman's last words. I feel the pressure of the Bloodfiend hierarchy, the very essence of which has infused my blood, intensify a degree higher—
感受到身后传来的妈妈最后的低语，以及血液中铭刻的血魔秩序似乎在某个瞬间更上一层的压迫时……

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
O Third Kindred, now...
三代眷属大人……是时候……

... Then, I wake.
我终于从梦中醒来。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
Report.
进展如何。

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
We have marched to the halfway point of the economy class section, as per Your Majesty's command.
遵照您的命令，目前游行已行进至经济舱的半途。

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
The procession's end is near... and so is the time for Your Majesty to join it at its rear.
游行队列即将抵达终点……王亲临队尾的时刻到了。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
Mm.
嗯。

As maman had commanded me, I fled La Manchaland to build my own kingdom.
在妈妈的命令下，我逃离了拉·曼却领，建立了属于我的王国。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
How many new Bloodbags have we gained?
血袋增加了多少？

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
A total of six today and not one more. I have relayed that no more than that is to be made, as per Your Majesty's decree.
今天共计6只。依您的指示，我已令他们不要再继续制造了。

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
And... as the time for you to create a new Kindred is nigh, I have set aside a few prospective passengers who may receive that honor.
另外……您创造新眷属的周期即将到来，因此我们挑选了部分乘客作为候选。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
Well done. I commend your efforts.
是吗。你的努力值得夸奖。

dataList.title:
Fourth Kindred
四代眷属
dataList.content:
... Anything for the kingdom and the Family's prosperity.
……一切都是为了王国与家族的繁荣。

It was rather convenient how the rules perfectly dovetailed with instinct.
规则与本能一致是如此方便。

The moment maman ceased to exist, my very instincts alerted to my ascension in the hierarchy.
妈妈逝去的瞬间，我本能地感受到自己的阶级上升了。

And with it, a sudden pressure sliced through me—the inescapable responsibility to propagate the Family, as I had no Children of my own.
并且由于我还没有子嗣，因此那种必须复兴家族的压力悄然向我袭来。

Indeed, I required a place where propagation of the Family was guaranteed, a furtive place that could hide our growth from foreign forces...
需要那种能够在其中扩大家族的同时……还难以被追踪者发现、不受外界势力影响的安全空间。

... making it a most reasonable decision to hide myself within the WARP train to escape P Corp.
……为了从P公司逃走，躲进WARP列车是最合理的选择。

No other place has so perfectly met the needs of my purpose, and none shall ever again.
如此完美契合我目标的空间，此前此后都不会再有。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
P-please, please don't kill me... Aagh!
救、救救我……咿啊！

The squire leads me to a room with a passenger, who is terrified out of his mind.
跟着侍从的脚步，我见到了一个吓得不知所措的乘客。

Terrified as he may be, and despite the considerable amount of time this train must have spent in stasis, there is a spark of life within him, desperately clawing to prolong its existence... And that makes him a prime candidate to join my Family.
不过，在长时间停滞的列车里仍然能保持理智，仍怀有对生存的渴望……的确是个有着成为家人的不错素养的人选。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
You need not be afraid.
无需恐惧。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
For I too, was once human.
我也曾身为人类。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
Hm. However, considering the City's standards of what constitutes a human and what does not, I still belong in the former category. Therefore, upon adjusting the distinction to "before Bloodfiend characteristics became apparent" and "after"...
嗯。按照都市规定的基准，现在也应该是人类。那么就从将我划分为具有血魔的特殊性之前与之后来看。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
But to me, the human existence and the princely existence...
对我而言……不论是身为人类的时期，还是作为王子的时期……

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
... were indistinguishable from one another.
都并不能令我感到有什么不同。

dataList.title:
Third Kindred
三代眷属
dataList.content:
Thus, the same shall be true to thee.
对汝……亦是如此。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
W-wait... what does that even mean?! That doesn't make any sense—!!!
等、等等……你在说什么，根本没道理啊！！！

I do not wait for him to finish his reply and sink my teeth into his jugular.
我不等他做出回答，便咬向了他的脖子。

Warm blood... spreads to every corner of my body.
能感受到那涌动的温热血液……正在流向我的全身。

Some may say that subjects of the King deserve to be heard. But that would be inefficient.
或许有人会主张国王应当倾听王国子民的话语，但那样效率太低。

I was given but two rules.
我被赋予了两项规则。

One, the march must never end.
游行不能停止。

Two, I must raise my kingdom.
建立我的王国。

... And no more.
……仅此而已。
